notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: The bug that affected the winning condition of the werewolf in the game when a player closed the game after dying has been fixed. The issue of buttons not working in the user interface where you can switch to ghost mode or return to the main menu when you die in the game has been resolved.

notes.title: A critical error related to the game's end conditions and buttons.
notes.notes: [b]Our team has identified a critical error related to the game's end conditions and non-functioning buttons in the endgame menu. We are working on it and will release a quick fix.[/b]

notes.title: About new pricing!
notes.notes: Hello valued players, as T&T Games, we have re-evaluated our pricing and agreed to permanently lower the price of Strange Town. We will not leave the players who have previously purchased the game behind, if they send an email to teamandtarget@outlook.com, we will provide them with an extra key.

notes.title: About playing the game alone.
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone, 

 We have noticed some of our friends who wanted to play the game alone and later had negative opinions about the game in our reviews. Strange Town is a project that can be played with at least 3 people. Today, we will release the necessary update. If you enter the game alone, you will never find a werewolf or have the basic motivation to play the game. This is a party game. 

Regards.
